'''Charlie Arlandson''' is a member of [[New Allies]]. He finished '''#12''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 16; Challonge seed 16).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
